idea-plugin.name: Circular Dependency Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Visualizes the dependency graph between modules of a multi-module Gradle or Maven project, and highlights real circular dependencies when they exist -- module/build-system level, not file/class-level "circular import" (already covered by other tools).

Gradle: parses settings.gradle(.kts) for declared include(...) modules, and each module's own build.gradle(.kts) for project(":...") dependency references (implementation, api, compileOnly, testImplementation, and other common configurations). Both Groovy and Kotlin DSL are supported.

Maven: parses each pom.xml's <modules> and cross-references <dependency> entries whose groupId:artifactId matches another module in the same project.

100% static text/XML analysis of files already open in your project -- no Gradle daemon, no Maven reactor build, no network call. A single-module project (no submodules declared) is reported honestly as "no cycles possible", never an empty, unexplained tool window.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.
